sidebar.title: Sidebar Sorting
sidebar.caption: How the sidebar entries (grouped by category) are ordered. Frequency and recent are read from apps.csv — opening a sidebar entry or launching an app increments the counters.
sidebar.statsHint: Frequency / recent are based on apps.csv; clearing resets all counters immediately.
desc.侧边栏: Sidebar sort rules: alphabetical / frequency / recently used
about.title: About
about.text: Configuration driven by ~/.config/LinuxCockpit/; abilities live under src/abilities.
animation.title: Page Transition
animation.caption: Transition effect when switching between sidebar abilities.
animation.modernMotionCaption: Master switch. On: theme changes ripple outward from a configurable origin, and page transitions are enabled. Off: all motion is disabled and themes swap instantly.
animation.themeTransitionCaption: Where the new theme expands from when switching: the top-left corner, or the current mouse position.
window.note: frameless/rounded take effect on next launch; background/fuse apply instantly. Layers: Background (bottom) → Fuse (middle) → Data (top). Fuse at 100% fully hides the background; lower it to reveal it. Image visibility = background opacity × (1 − fuse overlay opacity).
desc.外观: Theme, zoom, window, fuses, dashboard, launch and about
desc.界面动画: Modern motion master switch & page transitions
desc.settings.appearance: Theme, zoom, window, fuses, layout, launch and about
desc.settings.appearance.animations: Modern motion master switch & page transitions
settings.languageCaption: Switch language — reloads the page to apply.
settings.ability.title: Ability Toggle
settings.ability.description: Enable/disable abilities at runtime (current session only, not persisted). Disabled abilities' sidebar entries and commands are hidden immediately.
settings.ability.disabled: {name} disabled (sidebar entry and commands hidden immediately)
